test_cases.name: Verbose Quote Request for Multiple Items
test_cases.description: A verbose customer requests a quote for several catalog items, providing extra context and details, but does not reference any template or customer context directly. The system is expected to auto-select the unique customer template and create the quote.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Sales Quote – Multiple Items
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I hope this message finds you well. I am reaching out to request a formal sales quote for several items that we are considering for an upcoming promotional event at our retail locations. For planning purposes, it would be helpful to receive detailed pricing and availability information for the following products:

- 10 units of the WonderWagon Pull-Along Train
- 15 units of the SmartToys Building Blocks
- 20 units of the Generic Golden T-Shirt

If possible, please include any relevant lead times, shipping options, and any bulk purchase discounts that may apply. We are evaluating these products for a campaign scheduled next quarter, so timely information would be greatly appreciated. If you require any additional details from my side to proceed, please let me know.

Best regards,
Sarah Johnson

test_cases.name: Verbose polite quote request with explicit context
test_cases.description: A verbose and polite customer email requesting a quote for several catalog items, providing detailed business context and background, suitable for automatic template selection and quote creation.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Sales Quote – Danish Pastry Toy Division
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. My name is Anders Nielsen, and I am reaching out from Danish Pastry's toy division regarding an upcoming procurement initiative. We are currently evaluating several products for our seasonal retail assortment, and I would appreciate your assistance in preparing a formal sales quote for the following items:

- 10 units of the MagicToyland Fairy Doll
- 15 sets of SmartToys Building Blocks
- 5 WonderWagon Pull-Along Trains

If possible, please include any relevant details about lead times, available packaging options, and applicable discounts for bulk purchases. Our company has previously worked with your organization, so I trust you will have our customer information on file. Should you require any further details to proceed, please let me know.

Best regards,
Anders Nielsen

test_cases.name: Verbose informal quote request with detailed context
test_cases.description: A verbose, informal customer email requesting a quote for several catalog items, including extra context and explanations. The request is clear and catalog-grounded, allowing the system to auto-select the correct customer template and create the quote.

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request for Bakery Supplies and Toys
initial_turn.body:
Hey there,

I hope you’re having a good day! I’m reaching out from German Bakery to get a quote for a few items we’re planning to use both for our staff and for a small event we’re hosting next month. I want to make sure we get everything sorted in advance, so here’s what we’re looking for:

- 3 x Pizza (Item No: AITEM-0052) – these are for our lunch break catering, so please include any details about available sizes or crust types if relevant.
- 2 x Rasta Espresso Machine (Item No: AITEM-0029) – we’re expanding our coffee corner and need reliable machines.
- 5 x Generic Golden T-Shirt (Item No: AITEM-0019) – these will be used as uniforms for our event volunteers.
- 1 x JoySprout Toy Bicycle (Item No: AITEM-0013) – this is for a raffle prize for the kids attending the event.

If you need any more info about our company or the event, just let me know. Please send the quote as soon as you can, and let me know if you need anything else from my side.

Best regards,
Jakob Kuhs
